opportunities.title: This Week's Rules Chatter: What EN World's Nov 27 Digest Means for Your Table
opportunities.why_now: EN World's weekly digest just dropped, giving a fresh roundup of rules-adjacent news worth parsing for GMs who want the facts without the fluff.
opportunities.angle: Curated digest-of-the-digest: pull 3-4 rules/system items from the EN World roundup and add rules-first commentary on each

opportunities.title: The Only GM Gift Guide That Actually Reads the Rulebook
opportunities.why_now: EN World's 2026 GM gift guide just published right at the start of holiday shopping season, a perfect hook for a rules-literate counter-guide.
opportunities.angle: Annotated reaction list: take their picks and rate them by actual table utility/rules-support value, add a 'what they missed' section

opportunities.title: Damn You, Mystic Punks: Breaking Down the Rules Drama Everyone's Talking About
opportunities.why_now: This EN World thread just went up and is clearly sparking discussion, giving us a timely rules controversy to dissect while it's hot.
opportunities.angle: Rules-first explainer: lay out exactly what mechanic/ruling is contested and give a clear verdict with citations

opportunities.title: Your Character Isn't a Story, It's a Ruleset: A Rebuttal to Gnome Stew
opportunities.why_now: Gnome Stew's new essay on how we talk about characters is sparking narrative-first takes, and it's the perfect foil for a rules-first counterpoint.
opportunities.angle: Response piece: argue that character identity is built from mechanical choices (feats, builds, subclasses) as much as narrative, with concrete rule citations

opportunities.title: What Food Devils' Tactical Combat Can Teach Your TTRPG Action Economy
opportunities.why_now: Food Devils just launched in Early Access as a fantasy tactical RPG, offering a fresh, specific example to mine for action-economy design lessons.
opportunities.angle: Crossover rules analysis: break down a specific mechanic from the new release and map it to tabletop action economy design (PF2e, D&D4e-style tactics)
